posts.caption:
Motor City Comic Con is back in Novi.

One week out. Fall edition runs Fri Nov 13 to Sun Nov 15 at Vibe Credit Union Showplace. Weekend adult passes are $105, single days run $38 to $48, and the organizer's site has the full ticket list.

🗓 Nov 13 to 15
📍 Vibe Credit Union Showplace, 46100 Grand River Ave, Novi
